name: Soups & Stews
intro: The heart of the Nigerian table. From party egusi to everyday efo riro, these are the pots that go with every swallow and every pot of white rice.

name: Rice Dishes
intro: Smoky party jollof, fried rice and coconut rice. The pots that feed a crowd at every owambe, plus quicker versions for a weeknight.

name: Swallow
intro: Pounded yam, eba, amala and fufu. How to make every swallow smooth and free of lumps, and which soup to serve it with.

name: Small Chops & Snacks
intro: Puff-puff, moi moi, suya and the other small chops that disappear first at every party, made at home.

name: Breakfast
intro: Akara, yam and egg sauce, pap and more. Nigerian breakfasts for slow weekends and busy school mornings.

name: Drinks
intro: Zobo, kunu, Chapman and other Nigerian drinks, chilled and ready for hot afternoons and parties.

name: Desserts
intro: Chin chin, coconut candy, buns and other sweet things from Nigerian kitchens, for Christmas tins and everyday treats.
